images.caption:
Obadiah's Barrow Sited on the west side of Kittern Hill, this is the only one of the neolithic burial chambers on Gugh to have a popular name; Obadiah Hicks a prominent islander in the 19th century is credited with its rediscovery.
The chamber was excavated in 1901 and contained the remains of a contracted male skeleton and twelve cremation urns.
